mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (product_id, warehouse_id, quantity) VALUES (#{stock.productId}, #{stock.warehouseId}, #{stock.quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock SET quantity = quantity + #{quantity} WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS product_id, -- 商品ID p.name AS product_name, -- 商品名 p.code AS product_code, -- 商品编码 SUM(s.quantity) AS total_qty, -- SUM=求和：这个商品在【所有仓库】的库存加起来 COUNT(s.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count, -- COUNT(列)=数非NULL：这个商品占了几个仓库 -- >= 不涉及任何转义，语义等价且更省事。 CASE WHEN p.warning_qty >= SUM(s.quantity) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS warn_flag FROM stock s INNER JOIN product p ON s.product_id = p.id -- 关键分组：GROUP BY 后面写的列 = "按什么归成一类" GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.code, p.warning_qty ORDER BY total_qty DESC -- 库存多的排前面

SELECT w.id AS product_id, -- 这里复用 VO 的 productId 字段装仓库ID（见后文说明） w.name AS product_name, -- 复用 productName 装仓库名 SUM(s.quantity) AS total_qty, -- 该仓库所有商品库存总和 COUNT(s.product_id) AS warehouse_count, -- 这个仓库里有多少种商品 0 AS warn_flag -- 仓库维度暂不做预警，固定0 FROM stock s INNER JOIN warehouse w ON s.warehouse_id = w.id GROUP BY w.id, w.name ORDER BY total_qty DESC
